# Calendary

> Calendary is a lightweight, framework-agnostic PHP library for resolving calendar availability, busy periods and bookable time slots.

Calendary requires PHP 8.2+.

Important concepts:

- Availability defines when a resource can be available.
- `weekly` uses ISO weekdays: 1 = Monday through 7 = Sunday.
- Date-specific availability in `dates` completely overrides weekly availability for that date.
- An empty date-specific definition explicitly closes the date.
- `duration()` defines the duration of each generated slot.
- `interval()` defines the spacing between candidate slot start times and defaults to the configured duration.
- `breakTime()` defines additional unavailable time after an implicitly timed busy entry and defaults to `0`.
    Break time is applied only when Calendary infers the end of a busy period.
    Explicit `[start, end]` busy periods and whole-day busy entries are never extended by `breakTime()`.
- `busy()` represents occupied periods.
- `daysOff()` and `holidays()` explicitly block dates.
- Calendar resolution is timezone-aware.
- Date ranges are inclusive.
- Time periods use half-open `[start, end)` semantics.
- Calendary is independent of databases, ORMs and frameworks. Applications must normalize their data before passing it to `Calendary::load()`.

Day statuses:

- `open`: at least one slot is available.
- `closed`: no availability schedule applies.
- `full`: availability exists, but all slots are busy.
- `day_off`: explicitly marked as a day off.
- `holiday`: explicitly marked as a holiday.

Slot statuses:

- `available`
- `busy`

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](https://github.com/erilshackle/calendary-php/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): Installation and basic usage.
- [Availability](https://github.com/erilshackle/calendary-php/blob/main/docs/availability.md): Weekly schedules, date overrides, duration, interval, days off and holidays.
- [Busy Time](https://github.com/erilshackle/calendary-php/blob/main/docs/busy-time.md): Busy dates, periods and overlap semantics.
- [Querying](https://github.com/erilshackle/calendary-php/blob/main/docs/querying.md): `on()`, `weekOf()`, `between()`, filters and field selection.
- [Results](https://github.com/erilshackle/calendary-php/blob/main/docs/results.md): Day, Slot and Range result objects.
- [API Reference](https://github.com/erilshackle/calendary-php/blob/main/docs/api.md): Public API reference.
